children.text: How it works

Totem is a focus timer and app blocker for Android. You start a focus session by scanning an object on your desk, or a printed QR code, and the apps you chose stay blocked until you scan it again to finish.
For students, working professionals and late-night scrollers.
Features
A real object, like a notebook or a pen stand, is the main key.
Every totem also has a QR code as a backup key.
Pomodoro breaks pause blocking, then pick it back up.
Open Instagram mid-session and Pebble is waiting. The message changes with the moment.
Study groups join with an invite code. The leaderboard resets every Monday.
Each session feeds your streak and a weekly recap.
Blocking and focus sessions work without internet.
Emergency Unlock ends any session.
Status
Totem is Android only for now, and in early access before launch.
